recap.narration_text: Night speed must stay within lighted. Night lighting includes beam distance rules. Limit interior light and glare. Keep headlights clean and correctly aimed, and do not travel beyond the distance they illuminate. Use headlights from sunset to sunrise and dim high beams five hundred feet before an approaching vehicle or three hundred feet before passing another vehicle. Reduce dashboard brightness, use the visor against glare and avoid other interior lights at night.
